title: Assisted Living / Residential Care Facilities in Ohio
description:
In Ohio, assisted living facilities are officially known as Residential Care Facilities and are licensed by the Ohio Department of Health. These facilities offer a combination of housing and personal care services, providing an alternative to nursing homes for individuals who need assistance with daily living activities but don't require 24-hour skilled nursing care.
